task.description: Implement PAR-01, PAR-02, PAR-03, PAR-04 per the validated (PASS after 2 rework cycles) design artefacts. This is a large, high-risk implementation -- read ALL FOUR design docs in full before writing any code, they specify exact function signatures, error taxonomies, and several scope items added during rework that are NOT optional: (1) PAR-01: events/events_archive as PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at) from creation, PK widened to (event_id, created_at), new plat_event_idempotency table, widened composite FKs on event_payload_store/webhook_deliveries. (2) PAR-02: daily plat_partition_maintenance scheduled job (following src/scheduler/ conventions) provisioning lead_months=2 future partitions for BOTH events AND events_ephemeral (not just events -- this was a rework-2 addition), plat_partition_catalog + plat_partition_maintenance_run_log tables. (3) PAR-03: DETACH/ATTACH retention logic, events_ephemeral table (hand-written, same PARTITION BY/composite-PK pattern as events), retention_class column on event_type_registry, RetentionClassForbidden guard in Registry.registerType() (app-level check + DB CHECK constraint chk_retention_class_protected_family) added during rework 1, AND the append-time retention-class routing in Store.append() (via a new registry.getType() call, NOT widening validatePayload()'s signature) added during rework 2 that routes retention_class='delete' events to events_ephemeral instead of events. (4) PAR-04: AttachScanRequired CHECK-before-ATTACH validation helper. ALSO REQUIRED (rework 1 scope): retire/remove src/event_store/store.zig::Store.archive() entirely (confirmed zero production call sites) and REWRITE its 4 dependent test cases (TC-ES-07-01, TC-ES-07-02, TC-ADP-11-02, TC-ADP-11-03 in tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig) to assert retirement and exercise the new PartitionRetention mechanism instead -- TC-ADP-11-02 specifically must exercise the new append-time routing + real ephemeral-drop behavior end to end (a non-protected delete-class type appended, landing in events_ephemeral, then dropped). Do not leave any of these 4 tests referencing the removed archive() function.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in PAR-01, PAR-02, PAR-03, PAR-04 is implemented
Store.archive() fully removed, zero remaining references to it anywhere in src/ or tests/
TC-ES-07-01/02 and TC-ADP-11-02/03 rewritten and passing, exercising the new PartitionRetention mechanism (not the removed archive())
ES-07 and ADP-11 (both RELEASED) remain genuinely satisfied by the rewritten tests -- not just renamed, actually re-verified against the new mechanism
No mocks/stubs/fakes; all DB access via real PostgreSQL through the Pool
Real unit + integration tests written and passing for all new code, with own addTest/build.zig wiring (verified real by deliberate-break test)

result.summary: Implemented PAR-01 (migration 1147: events/events_archive rebuilt as PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at), PK widened to (event_id, created_at), plat_event_idempotency sidecar table for global idempotency-key uniqueness, widened composite FKs on event_payload_store/webhook_deliveries), PAR-02 (migration 1148 + src/scheduler/partition_maintenance.zig: daily plat_partition_maintenance job, proactively provisions lead_months=2 future partitions for BOTH events and events_ephemeral, idempotent via plat_partition_maintenance_run_log), PAR-03 (migration 1149 + src/scheduler/partition_retention.zig: DETACH/ATTACH archival aging with ADP-11-guarded ephemeral drop, events_ephemeral table, retention_class column + RetentionClassForbidden app-level guard in Registry.registerType() + chk_retention_class_protected_family DB CHECK constraint, Store.append() append-time routing of delete-class events to events_ephemeral via a new registry.getType() call), and PAR-04 (src/db/partition_attach.zig: verifyAttachConstraints()/attachPartitionTimed() CHECK-before-ATTACH validation helper). Store.archive() fully removed from src/event_store/store.zig (confirmed zero remaining references via git grep -- the surviving `.archive(` hits in src/ and tests/ all resolve to the unrelated definition.Store.archive()). TC-ES-07-01, TC-ES-07-02, TC-ADP-11-02, TC-ADP-11-03 rewritten in tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig against the new PartitionRetention mechanism; TC-ADP-11-02 exercises real end-to-end behavior: registers a non-protected delete-class event type (WIDGET_CREATED), appends via the real Store.append(), asserts the row lands in events_ephemeral (not events), then drives a real PartitionRetention.runEphemeralDrop() cycle against an isolated aged partition and confirms a genuine DROP TABLE occurred with the ADP-11 guard never tripping. During implementation, discovered and fixed two genuine bugs beyond the design docs' own scope: (1) a schema-agnostic catalog-introspection bug in the partition-seeding DO blocks (unqualified to_regclass()/pg_inherits lookups resolved through search_path to an already-seeded sibling schema's same-named partition, leaving tenant_default.events with zero attached partitions after a full migrate run -- fixed by scoping every existence check to current_schema()); (2) events/events_ephemeral's shared Store.append() INSERT path independently calling gen_random_uuid() twice (once in the plat_event_idempotency insert, once via the events/events_ephemeral column default), producing two different event_id values and permanently orphaning the idempotency sidecar row from the event row it should resolve to -- fixed by capturing plat_event_idempotency's generated event_id and binding it explicitly into the events/events_ephemeral INSERT. All validation gates re-run against a fully fresh bpm_dev and bpm_test (dropped and recreated, migrated from scratch) and pass with exit 0: zig build, zig build migrate (both databases), zig build check (PI-03 fmt gate), python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR), zig build test (full unit suite), zig build test-partition-attach, zig build test-partition-maintenance, zig build test-partition-retention, zig build test-integration-par02, zig build test-integration-par03, zig build test-integration-event-store (28/28 tests pass, 0 leaks, confirmed repeatable across two consecutive runs against the same persisted database). Build-wiring authenticity verified by deliberately breaking one assertion each in src/db/partition_attach.zig's unit test and tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig, confirming the respective build targets go red, then reverting.
